packages.title: Forsaken Spawn Room Only
packages.description:
FORSAKEN SPAWN ROOM ONLY
Forsaken's spawn room as a round-based map. You can't leave the room, so you play here the whole time. What makes this specific room so special is that this is one of the only rooms in the entirety of Cold War that continuously spawns zombies, meaning no break from zombies at all.

WHAT IS IN THE ROOM
- Der Wunderfizz, in place of the Death Perception machine. It is the only source of perks.
- Pack-a-Punch, inside the Main Street teleporter
- The Mystery Box
- The Armor Station and the Rampage Inducer
- The Exfil radio, on the crate in the corner of the room. It comes on at round 11 and every fifth round after that, like in a normal game. The helicopter picks you up in the spawn room.

BOX EXTRAS
The box in this mod carries all the weapons that exist in Cold War Zombies, including wonder weapons from other maps that usually wouldn't exist here. 

In order for this mod to function you must play on Forsaken. It will not do anything on any other map. 

NOT YET TESTED
- Whether the extra box weapons come out by chance. They were forced out of the box and worked, but nobody has seen them roll naturally yet.
- Other mods that change rounds, the box or the Exfil (The bot mod also has not been tried with it).

CREDITS
- grave (Discord): provided a code snippet that allowed for the spawning of machines in custom positions. .
- DK420187 (Discord): provided a full weapon name list used for the box weapons.

packages.title: Cheesy Menu
packages.description:
Cheesy Menu

A simple in-game mod menu for Cold War Zombies. I built it for messing around, practising and testing things in solo matches. Everything runs from a small menu in the bottom-left corner, so you don't need to touch any settings.

What's in it

Player

God Mode, Infinite Ammo, No Target
Noclip: fly with WASD, Jump to go up, Crouch to go down, Sprint to go faster
Third Person, Low Gravity, Move Speed
Max Ammo for all your guns, +1 Self Revive, Revive Me

Points & Salvage

Add 10k / 100k / 1M points, or set your points to 4,000,000
Add Salvage and Rare Salvage (on maps that use it)

Perks

Give any perk on its own, or all of them at once

Weapons

Pack-a-Punch your current gun, one level at a time up to III
Change your current gun's rarity, from Common to Legendary
Put any ammo mod on your current gun: Brain Rot, Cryo Freeze, Dead Wire, Napalm Burst, Shatter Blast
Spawn any wonder weapon, or any base weapon at the rarity you pick

Zombies & Rounds

One-Hit Kills, All Sprinters, Pause Spawning, Skip Round

Powerups

Drop Max Ammo, Insta-Kill, Double Points, Nuke, Carpenter, Fire Sale, Bonfire Sale, Free Perk or Death Machine in front of you

World

Teleport to crosshair, save and load your position
Open every door and debris for free, turn on the power
Slow motion

Controls

Open menu: hold Aim and press Melee
Scroll: Aim moves up, Fire moves down (hold to scroll faster)
Select: Reload or Interact
Back / close: Melee or Crouch

Good to know

Solo and private matches only. Mods don't run in public matchmaking.
Some options depend on the map. Salvage only works where the map uses it, and wonder weapons from other maps will have no sound.
Skip Round ends the current round, but any zombies still alive carry over into the next one.
Interact also selects, so if you're standing next to a wall-buy or door it might buy it. Use Reload to select if that gets annoying.

Made by the_sir_cheese.

~ A little help from AI.

packages.title: Nikolai Zombies Toolkit
packages.description:
Nikolai Zombies Toolkit brings convenient gameplay shortcuts to your solo Cold War Zombies matches. Experiment with weapon upgrades, restock supplies, and customize your survival experience without opening a menu.

FEATURES

• Add 25,000 points per use.
• Toggle invincibility on or off.
• Refill ammunition for your carried weapons.
• Add 1,000 regular Salvage and 100 High-Grade Salvage.
• Add one Field Upgrade charge, up to its maximum capacity.
• Upgrade your current weapon by one Pack-a-Punch level, up to Level III.
• View a compact shortcut guide when you need it.

CONTROLS

Hold Aim, then press:

• Interact → Add 25,000 points.
• Reload → Toggle invincibility.
• Melee → Refill ammunition.
• Jump → Upgrade your current weapon.

For the following combinations, hold the first two buttons BEFORE pressing Aim:

• Reload + Melee, then Aim → Add Salvage.
• Interact + Melee, then Aim → Recharge your Field Upgrade.
• Interact + Reload, then hold Aim for two seconds → Show the shortcut guide.

Release the buttons after each combination before using another shortcut.

USAGE NOTES

• This version supports Solo matches only.
• Controls follow your in-game button bindings.
• Buttons retain their normal gameplay actions.
• Weapon upgrades depend on the weapon and the upgrade system being available.
• Salvage and Field Upgrade features require their corresponding systems to be active.
• Aiming alone does not display the shortcut guide.

Created by Nikolai.Kw & AI

packages.title: Quick Restart
packages.description:
QUICK RESTART

Restart your Zombies match quickly. Vote to restart at any time, or let the mod restart for you when your team goes down, without going back through the menus.

HOW TO RESTART
Hold the Interact button for 7 seconds to vote for a restart. When more than half of the players in the match have voted, a message shows for 3 seconds and the match restarts. Votes expire after about 30 seconds, and players who leave stop counting. AI teammates from the bot mod do not count and cannot vote.

Seven seconds is longer than the normal hold actions I know of (a revive takes about 5), so you will not vote by accident.


SETTINGS
Settings are read when the mod loads, so choose them before you start your match.
- Auto-Restart on Death (on by default): restarts after your whole team is down.
- Always Skip Map Intro (off by default): also skips the intro on normal loads, not only after a restart.
- Fast Game Over (off by default): skips the scoreboard. Auto-restart happens after half a second instead of 8 seconds, and when you quit from the pause menu the game-over screen is shorter, so you reach the lobby sooner. Easter egg and exfil victory screens are left alone. Leave this off if you want time to read your stats.

GOOD TO KNOW
- A restart resets the match. Points, weapons and progress all start over.
- A vote restart lets the game write your run's stats before restarting, the way it does when you leave from the pause menu.
- Before a vote restart you will see the game-over screen and hear the game-over sound for about a second (This is normal and intended).
- Fast Game Over also shortens the Trials results screen.
- A restart fires the game's end-of-match event, so mods that react to a game ending may react to a restart, future-proofing compatability with other "gamemode mods" as long as they are coded correctly. (If you're a mod dev interested in making your mod compatable, DM me)

NOT YET TESTED
- Whether stats and XP are saved correctly after a restart. The launcher records none for unreleased mods, so this could not be checked.

The goal is to strip away many of the arcade-style systems and replace them with mechanics that feel closer to a military survival experience.

Players have to rely more on positioning, scavenging, weapon choice, movement, teamwork, and the environment.

Reworked Mystery Box

Reworked weapon rarity and attachments

Randomized physical floor weapons

Wall-buy replacements

Physical ammunition and armor supplies

Reworked Outbreak rewards

Permanent character upgrades earned through gameplay

Reworked armor

More realistic weapon handling and recoil (PC Only)

Weapon-specific stamina behavior

Reduced bunny hopping and movement exploits

Injury and low-health mechanics

Adrenaline response at critical health

Friendly fire / team damage

Rebalanced normal, armored, special, and elite enemies

Armored zombies are slower but significantly tougher

Rebalanced boss health for co-op

Reworked melee weapons and gun-butt attacks

Rebalanced explosives and launchers

Vehicle durability

packages.title: SANDBOX - Zombies Toolkit v1.1
packages.description:
SANDBOX - Zombies Toolkit

A lightweight in-game menu for experimenting, practicing and messing around in Cold War Zombies. Built for solo and private matches. Everything is controlled from a simple on-screen menu, with no setup needed.

This is an open beta. If something doesn't work on a map, or you find a bug, please leave a comment with the map name and what happened.

FEATURES

Player
- God Mode, Infinite Ammo, No Target (zombies ignore you)
- Fly Mode (Jump = up, Crouch = down, Sprint = faster)
- Super Speed (1.5x / 2x / 3x)
- Give All Perks
- Add Points or Set Points To an exact amount (up to 4,000,000)
- Revive / Respawn yourself if you're downed or spectating

Weapons & Upgrades
- Spawn any base weapon or wonder weapon at the rarity you choose (Common to Legendary)
- Change the rarity of the gun in your hand
- Pack-a-Punch your current weapon to level 1, 2 or 3
- Apply any ammo mod: Brain Rot, Cryo Freeze, Dead Wire, Napalm Burst, Shatter Blast

Loot
- Armor (levels 1-3) and Self Revives
- Salvage and Rare Salvage in adjustable amounts (on maps that use salvage)
- Equipment: frags, semtex, molotovs, monkey bombs, stims
- Scorestreaks: Chopper Gunner, Death Machine, Sentry Turret, Napalm, Artillery, and more

Zombies
- Spawn zombies, specials (Hellhound, Mangler, Mimic, Tempest, Tormentor) and bosses (Krasny Soldat, Abomination, Orda) at your crosshair
- Freeze / unfreeze zombies, turn them into crawlers, One-Hit Zombies
- Teleport zombies to your crosshair or bring them to you
- Kill all zombies or end the current round

Troll / Fun
- Pick any player in your match to freeze, teleport to you, teleport to, or revive/respawn

World
- Drop any powerup: Max Ammo, Insta-Kill, Double Points, Nuke, Carpenter, Fire Sale
- Save / load your position, teleport to your crosshair
- Open all doors, turn on power

HOW TO USE

Open menu ........ Aim (ADS) + Melee
Scroll ........... ADS = up, Fire = down (hold to scroll fast)
Select ........... Reload
Back / Close ..... Melee

Options with a value in brackets, like "Add Points [+5,000]":
1. Select it with Reload
2. Change the value with ADS / Fire
3. Press Reload to confirm, or Melee to cancel

The controls are also shown on screen when the match starts, and in any empty space in the menu.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS
- The menu takes a second or two to fade after you close it. Settings has a beta "Bottom-Screen Display" that closes instantly, but it may not show on every setup. If the menu disappears after turning it on, press Reload again to switch back.
- Some features depend on the map (salvage, power, specials and bosses).
- Frozen zombies stop the round from ending until you unfreeze them.
